AI and Cybersecurity: Strategies for Resilience and Defense is a four-week, live online program from MIT xPRO designed for senior technology leaders, cybersecurity professionals, and risk and IT managers. This program explores how artificial intelligence and machine learning are reshaping the cybersecurity landscape and how you can stay ahead of evolving threats.
Through interactive live sessions with MIT faculty and real-world case studies, you will gain practical tools to build resilient, AI-integrated security strategies, navigate the risks of AI-driven systems, and lead with confidence at the critical intersection of cybersecurity and emerging technology.
WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
MIT xPRO is collaborating with online education provider Emeritus to deliver this online course. By clicking LEARN MORE, you will be taken to a page where you can download the brochure and apply to the program via Emeritus.
• Address the risks AI brings to both defense and offense in cybersecurity
• Manage AI’s ethical and governance challenges, especially when dealing with Shadow AI and AI system abuse
• Build skills to design strong defenses against AI-powered cybercrime
WHO SHOULD ENROLL
• Chief Technology Officers, CISOs, and Senior IT Leaders tasked with setting enterprise-wide strategy for AI adoption and cybersecurity resilience.
• Cybersecurity, Risk, and Compliance Executives responsible for securing systems, managing AI governance, and navigating evolving regulatory landscapes.
• Digital Transformation and Innovation Leaders implementing AI tools and automation while ensuring alignment with security protocols and business objectives.
• Technical Leads in AI, Data, or Infrastructure Roles who oversee the design, deployment, or defense of AI systems and need to address threats like adversarial attacks, model abuse, and Shadow AI.
